cards.ex: I was just dropping by to say hello before heading to the airport.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki aeroportga ketishdan oldin salomlashib ketish uchun o'tib turuvdim.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa muddatga tashrif buyurish, ko'rishib ketish ma'nosida.

cards.ex: Deadlines are always tight, you know how it is.
cards.exUz: Muddatlar har doim qisqa, bilasan-ku.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat qandayligini tushuntirish uchun ishlatiladi, hamma shunday ekanligini nazarda tutadi.

cards.ex: Hey Mark, how's tricks? Been a while!
cards.exUz: Hey Mark, ishlar qalay? Ancha bo'ldi ko'rishmaganimizga!
cards.uzDef: Salomlashish va ishlar qanday ketayotganini so'rashning norasmiy usuli.

cards.ex: Keep me in the loop about any progress on the project.
cards.exUz: Loyiha bo'yicha har qanday o'zgarishlardan meni xabardor qilib turing.

cards.ex: I hate making small talk at parties.
cards.exUz: Men ziyofatlarda g'ayri-jiddiy suhbatlashishni yomon ko'raman.

cards.ex: She's really on top of things since she became the manager.
cards.exUz: U menejer bo'lganidan beri hammasini nazorat ostida ushlab turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Hammasini nazorat ostida ushlab turish, muvaffaqiyatli bajarish.

cards.ex: So, we need to finish this by Friday, get the picture?
cards.exUz: Shunday qilib, biz buni juma kuniga qadar tugatishimiz kerak, tushundingmi?

cards.ex: I'm just thinking aloud, don't take it too seriously.
cards.exUz: Men shunchaki o'ylab gapiryapman, buni juda jiddiy qabul qilmang.
cards.uzDef: Shunchaki fikrlarni og'zaki ifodalash, o'ylab gapirish.

cards.ex: Hey, what's the buzz around the office today?
cards.exUz: Hey, bugun ofisda nima gaplar?

cards.ex: The meeting's over, so that's that.
cards.exUz: Uchrashuv tugadi, shu bilan tugadi.

cards.ex: How's everything coming along with the new house?
cards.exUz: Yangi uy bilan ishlar qanday ketyapti?
cards.uzDef: Barcha ishlar yoki loyihalar qanday rivojlanayotganini so'rash.

cards.ex: Give me a ring when you get a chance.
cards.exUz: Imkon bo'lganda menga qo'ng'iroq qiling.

cards.ex: That reminds me, I need to buy milk.
cards.exUz: Esimga tushdi, men sut sotib olishim kerak.

cards.ex: I heard through the grapevine that they're planning layoffs.
cards.exUz: Men pinhona manbalardan ularning ishdan bo'shatishni rejalashtirayotganlarini eshitdim.

cards.ex: I saw him just the other day at the supermarket.
cards.exUz: Men uni yaqinda supermarketda ko'rdim.

cards.ex: I know it's been tough, how are you holding up?
cards.exUz: Bilaman, qiyin bo'ldi, qalaysiz?

cards.ex: He called me out of the blue after years of silence.
cards.exUz: U menga yillar davomidagi sukutdan so'ng kutilmaganda qo'ng'iroq qildi.

cards.ex: Be that as it may, we still need to consider the budget.
cards.exUz: Shunday bo'lsa ham, biz hali ham byudjetni ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bir fikrga rozi bo'lmasdan, boshqa fikrni aytish.

cards.ex: The thing is, I don't have enough money.
cards.exUz: Gap shundaki, menda yetarli pul yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Muhim bir fikrni aytishdan oldin ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: Hey, what's cooking in your world these days?
cards.exUz: Hey, bu kunlarda sening dunyoda nima yangiliklar bor?

cards.ex: How's your new job? Not too shabby, actually!
cards.exUz: Yangi ishing qanday? Yomon emas, aslida!

cards.ex: On second thought, maybe we should take a taxi.
cards.exUz: O'ylab ko'rib, ehtimol, taksi olishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: I'm not sure if I can do it, but I'll give it a shot.
cards.exUz: Men buni qila olamanmi, bilmayman, lekin harakat qilib ko'raman.

cards.ex: My grandfather is 90 but he's fit as a fiddle.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom 90 yoshda, lekin u juda sog'lom.
cards.uzDef: Juda sog'lom va baquvvat ekanligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: At the end of the day, it's your decision.
cards.exUz: Oxirida, bu sizning qaroringiz.
cards.term: At the end of the day

cards.ex: We're considering moving to London. Any thoughts on that?
cards.exUz: Biz Londonga ko'chib o'tishni o'ylayapmiz. Bu haqida fikring bormi?

cards.ex: For what it's worth, I think you're doing a great job.
cards.exUz: Qadrlashga arzirli bo'lsa, menimcha, siz ajoyib ish qilyapsiz.
cards.uzDef: O'z fikrini kiritishdan oldin ishlatiladi, garchi muhim bo'lmasa ham.

cards.ex: To cut a long story short, we won the game.
cards.exUz: Qisqasi, biz o'yinda g'alaba qozondik.
cards.term: To cut a long story short

cards.ex: The project failed, so we're back to square one.
cards.exUz: Loyiha muvaffaqiyatsiz tugadi, shuning uchun biz boshidan boshlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi holatga qaytish, boshidan boshlash kerak bo'lish.

cards.ex: You started the new diet last week, how's that treating you?
cards.exUz: Siz o'tgan hafta yangi parhezni boshladingiz, bu sizga qanday ta'sir qilyapti?
cards.uzDef: Yangi holat, ish yoki boshqa narsa qanday ta'sir qilayotganini so'rash.
